title: Get lifetime access to all your favorite AI models for a one-time payment of $65
content_html:
TL;DR: Get lifetime access to flagship AI models and create images, audio, and video with a 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan on sale for $64.97 (reg. $540).

Credit: 1minAI

$64.97
$540 Save $475.03

Most AI subscriptions tie you to one company’s models for a monthly fee. If you’d rather pay once and switch between models as you work, get a 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan lifetime subscription. 1min.AI is an all-in-one AI app that gives you models for writing, generating images, editing audio, and creating videos, and this plan is on sale for $64.97 (reg. $540) right now.

All your AI models in one place

Instead of picking a single AI model, 1min.AI gives you the flagship models all in one place, including GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude 4.6 Sonnet, and Gemini 3.1 Pro. You can choose the model that suits each task without signing up for each one separately. For writing, 1min.AI has a blog article generator, rewriter, summarizer, grammar checker, and keyword research tool, plus a brand voice generator to keep your copy consistent.

On the creative side, you can generate and upscale images, remove backgrounds or objects, and turn a rough sketch into a finished picture. Audio tools convert text to speech, transcribe recordings, clone voices, and generate music. Video tools create clips from text or images and summarize or caption YouTube videos. You can also upload PDFs and other documents and ask for summaries, translations, or answers.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

Your plan includes 4,000,000 credits per month. That’s enough for up to 1,112,500 words, 1,186 images, or 37 videos per month, depending on how you use them. Visiting the web app daily earns another 15,000 free credits, up to 450,000 per month, and those free credits never expire. Up to 20 members can share the account with member management and collaboration tools, and storage, the prompt library, and brand voices are all unlimited.

Pay once for AI chat, images, audio, and video.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Through Dec. 6, you can get a 1min.AI Advanced lifetime subscription on sale for $64.97.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
